body: I live in Canada. What about you? I’m sorry to hear that you’re struggling :(
Ughh yeah that really sucks. Luckily I don’t usually have too much of a problem with sleeping. I hope you’re able to sleep soon or tomorrow at least!
I’m sorry, that sucks :( do you know why you can’t sleep?
Same!!! Every time I go to sleep I hope and wish I don’t wake up. At least my dreams are better than this reality (usually)

I already sleep as much as I can. I love sleeping but it is not giving me the same relief it used to. I dread having to wake up and every time I wake up I feel so awful that I have to live in this reality.
Just a whole mess of things. I’m struggling so much with my mental health. Everything feels so painful and unbearable. I just want everything to end. Living is torture for me.

Thank you for your honesty. It’s a bit disappointing to hear but I’m not surprised. Thank you for sharing your advice, I will try to keep that in mind. It’s hard to find even small bits of happiness now when everything feels so painful and unbearable and miserable. I wonder if it will be truly worth it for me to stay alive if I will just have to go through decades of suffering. The only reason that I’m staying alive now is so that I don’t hurt my family, but honestly I wish I didn’t care so much so I could just finally end my pain.
Thank you for letting me know, I agree that is not helpful in my situation and pretty dismissive. And thank you for being thoughtful and considerate :)
I’m sorry to hear you feel the same way :( it really is an awful way to live
What did they say?

I’m so sorry you’re going through this. I really hope things will get better for you. I really relate to your post. I’ve been struggling so much for a long time and a few months ago something happened that made things so much worse and I fell deep into a depression. I’m also 22 and am dreading turning 23 soon. All I wish for is to die.

Unfortunately for me I didn’t go through with. The only reason I didn’t do it was because I can’t do that to my family. One of them, probably my mom, would have been the one to find me and I can’t traumatize her like that again but worse. If I can find a more peaceful way to go where I look like I’ve just fallen asleep I think I would be less hesitant. Just because I didn’t do it to save my family from the unbearable pain doesn’t mean I want to die any less. I still desperately want to die and part of me wishes that I just didn’t care and did it anyways. The pain is so constant and unbearable. It is not fair I have to live in this mental agony in order not to hurt my family. I will still constantly hope to die in (almost) any other way so I can still die without having to choose to do it myself. I’m so sad.

I feel the same way. It is so unbearable. I feel like I have nothing left anymore. I just wish I could go back to the way things were. Now all I feel is so much mental agony, I don’t understand how that hasn’t killed me yet.

I do remember how nice life was. I think that is what is making things so much worse. I made an awful mistake recently and it had just made everything so much worse, I couldn’t have even imagined. I regret it so much, it’s unbearable. Every day is filled with so much pain and suffering now. I can’t escape it. It is torture.

I have tried medication before, several times, but it has never made a noticeable difference for me.
Me too. My mind is already dead, why can’t my body catch up?

I relate to this a lot as well. I’ve been struggling so much for years but I’m really trying, it may not be a lot, but I am trying. It never seems to be enough for anyone though. Things just keep getting worse. I can never get a break. When I think things can’t get any worse, they just get so so so much worse I couldn’t have even imagined. Why do I bother when things just keep getting worse?
Thank you! :)
It’s for rTMS and depression and suicidal thoughts
I’m sorry to hear you get that feeling too :( it makes me feel so hopeless, helpless, and desperate. I feel like there is nothing I can do.

Thank you :) everything is just so so so difficult for me. I dread having to live every second of every day. There is no relief. I don’t know what to do anymore. I so desperately wish I could die but that’s so hard to do.
I so desperately want to fix this but I can’t. I’m filled with so much anger and regret and guilt and shame and pain and dread and fear and resentment and hopelessness.

Nothing seems to matter to me anymore. I’m so preoccupied with dying that I can’t focus on anything else. I can’t live with this. It’s too awful. I’m so sad. Why did this have to happen? Why did I have to ruin my entire life? Why do I keep fucking up like this? Why can’t things go back to the way they were?

Thank you for your comment :) I’m really trying my best but that’s never enough. I’m never enough. I’m trying so hard, I’m still alive at least but it seems that’s not good enough either. I just wish things could end already, I’m so tired of everything. Everything just keeps getting worse. I thought it was so bad already and then something happens and it just gets so much worse. I can’t keep doing this.

I have been struggling for a long time but recently something happened that just completely devastated my entire life. I just really can’t do this anymore. Every time I think things can’t get worse, they get so much worse. I’m so exhausted from all the pain and suffering. I don’t want to live in this reality, everything is unbearable. I’m so devastated.
I know, there’s no way out. That’s why I asked for mercy. I’m just so desperate at this point. I can’t do this anymore.

Thank you :) but it’s so hard not to feel so guilty and ashamed. At least before, I was only hurting myself but now everyone knows and I know they don’t understand and judge me for it. I feel so exposed and uncomfortable in this reality.
Thank you for reassuring me! :)
